decision: Never total, score or rank readings by party
why: Same reason named ministers are never ranked: an unchecked model's output would become a verdict, and a misleading account of proceedings can be a contempt
result: rule added to CLAUDE.md

decision: Adopt the Claude Design mock's look and layout, not its copy or numbers
why: The mock's text and figures are illustrative; docs/site-copy.md stays the only source of wording
evidence: text-node diff of 9 routes before and after: only the wordmark's question mark moved into its own span
result: app/src/styles/tokens.css, all copy unchanged

decision: Decline the mock's Not answered % column, red emphasis and sort by most not answered
why: A sortable not-answered share is a ranking of portfolios, which BROWSE_COMPARISON_NOTE and the site rules rule out
result: Browse keeps sort by name and by number of questions

decision: Decline the mock's how sure 0.66 decimals, three-way method comparison, calibration chart and error counts
why: Probability reads N in 100, and the 300-pair benchmark that would supply those numbers is not done
result: card styles reused for existing method content only

decision: Reading chips are dark text on a tint, never a saturated fill
why: A table column of solid red reads as a verdict on a portfolio; all chip pairs pass 4.5:1
evidence: contrast computed for every new text and background pair, lowest 5.02
result: .chip in app/src/styles/global.css

decision: Teal holds text copied from the record, gold holds model output, and a box never mixes them
why: Lets a reader see at a glance which words are Parliament's and which are the model's
result: .source-box and .gold-box on Home, Method and the question page

decision: The preview notice rides under the page banner as a full-width strip
why: Banners are full bleed, so the shell can no longer place the notice above the route; one component keeps it to exactly one per route
result: app/src/components/page-banner.tsx
